title: Technical manual genre profile (Layer 2 — functional roles)
description: Functional-role vocabulary for TECHNICAL MANUALS (product manuals, SOPs, installation/repair guides). A role is an OPTIONAL second label on a layer-1 block; each role declares the layer-1 kind(s) it may attach to.
$comment: Safety severity (danger/warning/caution/notice, ANSI Z535.6) is NOT a set of separate roles — it is marker vocabulary carried by the L3 ansi_z535_lexicon.json onto the single safety_notice role. Consistency: every role.attaches_to is non-empty.
